qs.e: Autosomal recessive. Homogentisic acid (HGA) accumulates → oxidizes and polymerizes → ochronosis (blue-black pigmentation of connective tissue: ear cartilage, sclerae, tendons). Urine turns dark on standing (oxidation of HGA). Complications: ochronotic arthropathy (spine, large joints), cardiac valve involvement. Benign in childhood, symptomatic in adulthood. Treatment: low protein diet + nitisinone (blocks HGA produ
